about: Planted decor.css cases for tests/unit/py/test_preset_lint.py. {S} stands for .cs-slide[data-preset="swiss"]. strict and loose are the sets of finding codes preset_lint.lint_css must return with and without --strict (a legacy preset passes loose). A case with a replay block also states the computed style a browser reports for that css and the flags the real replaySupportCheck (src/paint/replay.js, run by replay-probe.mjs) raises on it: the test checks both, and that the strict codes are exactly the lint codes of those flags (rule A6: what the replay painter refuses, the strict lint refuses). Wave 2b adds the cases that read a custom property and the fallback of a var() for what they stand for, and `sizes`: decor.css fixtures (a rule repeated up to `bytes`, per part) for decision D-7, the first 20 KiB of rules scoped to a cover or a poster do not count toward the strict 25 KiB limit; a selector that leaves the slide (a sibling combinator right after the cover, + or ~) is not scoped, and the cases that follow custom properties to the end of a chain (five and forty deep, the seventeenth definition of one property) hold the lint to the whole chain, saying decor.var-limit where a value stands for more whole values than it lists.
